name: Theaetetus
biography: Credited with completing the theory of the five regular solids (set out in Euclid Book XIII) that underlies the Timaeus's geometric theory of the elements, and with first proving there are exactly five such solids. The young mathematician who proposes, in the dialogue named for him, the first and only definition of knowledge Russell considers: 'knowledge is nothing but perception.'
